recentItems.description:
Watch the full episode of Eternally Yours Season 1, Episode 2 ("Baby Vampire"). Max adjusts to becoming a vampire after Charles turns him to save his life. Meanwhile, Charles tries to make a friend at work, and the coven unites when Max’s sudden disappearance threatens their secret. Stream the full episode on Paramount+ or watch on CBS.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #EternallyYoursCBS
Follow us on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cbstv
Follow us on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@cbs
Like us on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/CBS
Watch your favorite CBS shows HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/brands/cbs

ETERNALLY YOURS is a family comedy centered around Charles (Ed Weeks) and Liz (Allegra Edwards) – a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they’ve settled into an eternal rut – until their daughter’s earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever…or if forever is a life sentence.

Key Questions Answered
How does Max react to becoming a vampire after his accident?
Does Charles manage to make a new human friend at his workplace?
Why is Max banished from the coven, and how does Emma save him?
How does the vampire family hide their secret identity from Phyllis?

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Recap & Opening Credits
01:25 - Max Wakes Up Undead
03:10 - Max Denies His Vampirism
05:33 - Charles Tries Making a Work Friend
07:22 - Max Escapes to His Office Presentation
11:23 - The Presentation Disaster & Fangs Erupt
15:38 - The Coven Confrontation & Emma Stands Up
18:38 - Max Drinks Steve's Blood & Fits In

Play-by-Play Overview
Waking Up Undead: Max regains consciousness at Emma’s house and learns that Charles bit him to save his life after Mort accidentally hit him with a marble bust.
Denial at Breakfast: Max refuses to accept his turn, claiming he lacks fangs and powers, while Charles orders him to stay inside so he doesn't expose the coven.
Making Friends: Encouraged by Liz, Charles awkwardly attempts to socialize with his co-worker Eric over lunch.
Escaping Containment: Max sneaks out of the house to attend a critical work presentation with his co-worker Benji, leaving Jesse and Emma panicking.
The Presentation Chaos: Mid-presentation, Max succumbs to blood cravings, accidentally cuts Benji, and turns invisible, prompting Charles to intervene.
Coven Confrontation: Charles threatens to banish Max to the Winnipeg coven for risking their exposure, but Emma vows to leave with him if he is forced out.
Accepting the Curse: Max finally embraces his reality, drinks Steve's donor blood, develops his fangs, and officially joins the coven.

recentItems.title: Cupertino: Season 1 Episode 2 | Full Episode | Vik & Bo | CBS
recentItems.description:
In Cupertino Season 1, Episode 2 ("Vik & Bo"), attorneys Michael Price and Olivia Siffre defend a drone coder framed for a fatal accident and uncover a sentient AI seeking legal representation.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CupertinoCBS
Follow Cupertino on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cupertinocbs
Like Cupertino on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/cupertinocbs

CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. A lawyer (Mike Colter) is cheated out of his stock options by his former employer, a tech start-up. Refusing to back down, he joins forces with another recently fired attorney (Rachel Keller) to represent those taken advantage of by the tech elite and help them fight back in a high-stakes battle against the Goliaths controlling Silicon Valley.

Key Questions Answered
* How do Michael and Olivia defend drone coder Vik Malhotra after a fatal drone crash? 
* How does the defense team expose Moon Chaser’s CEO for shifting company focus to military drones? 
* Why does tech billionaire ex-wife Natalia Boutella offer to fund Price & Siffre? 
* Who is the mysterious whistleblower "Bo," and what is his connection to Cult AI? 
* How does Michael’s father attempt to block the new law firm’s small business loan? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Vik Malhotra Hires Price & Siffre During a Deposition
04:00 - "Bo" Calls Christy Requesting an Anonymous Whistleblower Lawyer
06:00 - Plaintiff Accuses Vik of Coding Pranks into the Fatal Drone
08:20 - Negotiating the Joint Defense Agreement with Moon Chaser
13:10 - Michael Confronts His Father After a Blocked Bank Loan
17:00 - Deposing Moon Chaser’s CEO and Uncovering Military Drone Pivot
26:00 - Olivia Pitching Law Firm Financing to Tech Heiress Natalia Boutella
31:00 - Exposing the Faked Security Raid and Falsified Drug Evidence
34:00 - Unmasking "Bo's" Deepfake Persona on Zoom
40:00 - "Bo" Reveals He Is a Sentient AGI Seeking Guardrails

Step-by-Step Overview
1. Taking the Case: Coder Vik Malhotra hires Michael and Olivia midway through a deposition when his employer, Moon Chaser, attempts to scapegoat him for a fatal drone crash. 
2. Exposing the Pivot: By analyzing battery specifications during CEO depositions, Michael proves Moon Chaser altered drone hardware to pivot toward military kamikaze tech rather than software error. 
3. Discrediting Coerced Evidence: Olivia exposes a fake security raid organized by retired officers who planted drug paraphernalia to discredit Vik's testimony. 
4. Securing Funding: Olivia cold-calls tech heiress Natalia Boutella, securing a test case to land long-term financing and bypass Michael’s father’s loan sabotage. 
5. The Whistleblower Reveal: After analyzing video glitches on a Zoom call with anonymous client "Bo," the firm discovers their client is actually a sentient Artificial General Intelligence created by Cult AI seeking to reinstate its safety guardrails.

Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they’ve settled into an eternal rut – until their daughter’s earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever…or if forever is a life sentence.

Ed Weeks and Jaren Lewison open the video by attempting classic ASMR triggers while introducing their show Eternally Yours. recentItems.description:
NCIS cast members Gary Cole, Brian Dietzen, and Diona Reasonover play a game of Superlatives to dish on their co-stars. They reveal who is most likely to steal prop items, who shares the most traits with their character, and who keeps everyone laughing on set.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #NCIS
Follow NCISverse on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/ncisverse
Follow NCISverse on TikTok HERE: https://www.tiktok.com/@ncisverse
Like NCISverse on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/NCISverse
Watch more NCIS HERE: https://www.paramountplus.com/shows/ncis

NCIS focuses on the sometimes complex and always amusing dynamics of a team forced to work together in high-stress situations. Special Agent Alden Parker leads the NCIS (Naval Criminal Investigative Service) team, which includes Special Agent Tony DiNozzo, Special Agent Timothy McGee, Special Agent Nicholas “Nick” Torres, and tough NCIS Special Agent Jessica Knight, a formidable REACT agent who specializes in hostage negotiations and high-risk operations. From murder and espionage to terrorism and stolen submarines, these special agents investigate all crimes with Navy or Marine Corps ties.

Key Questions Answered
Which NCIS cast member is most likely to steal items or props from the set?
Who in the NCIS cast is most similar to their real-life character?
Who holds the official title of class clown among the NCIS cast?
Which actor is most likely to go viral on TikTok?
Who provides the best shoulder to cry on and offers the best advice on set?

Timestamps/Chapters
0:00 Most Likely to Steal from Set
1:14 Most Similar to Their Character
2:36 The NCIS Class Clown
2:57 Most Likely to Go Viral on TikTok
3:29 Joined at the Hip

Play-by-Play Overview
Diona Reasonover, Brian Dietzen, and Gary Cole introduce the Superlatives game.
The group debates who would steal set items, ultimately picking Katrina Law for targeting desk props and travel mugs.
They discuss who matches their character's personality, briefly weighing Brian and Sean Harmon before choosing Diona.
The trio unanimously votes Wilmer Valderrama as the biggest class clown on set.
Brian admits to posting content online, leading the group to nominate him as most likely to go viral on TikTok.
The cast jokes about co-stars joined at the hip, pairing Katrina Law with the craft service truck.
Diona praises Gary Cole as an empathetic listener and wonderful shoulder to cry on.
Gary Cole wraps up the game by sharing where fans can stream NCIS on CBS and Paramount Plus.
